ignored_methods.cloud_upload: Not exposed as an MCP tool yet; low demand and would require additional schema for file payloads.
ignored_methods.get_text_grades: New in edupage-api 0.13.0 (text grades / commendations). Deliberately not surfaced yet: get_grades already returns the numeric gradebook, and adding a tool is a surface decision that needs the rule 3 sync points (tool floor, GLAMA_EXPECTED_TOOLS, README count, e2e manifests) plus a Glama re-grade. Revisit when someone asks for commendations.
